name: Middle Tennessee State University
tuition_note: 2026-27 in-state (TN resident) undergraduate tuition & fees ($11,424 annual) from mtsu.edu Cost of Attendance page. Housing is room only, standard/traditional residence hall shared room at $3,376/term x 2 = $6,752/year from mtsu.edu/living-on-campus/rates (Fall 2026 & Spring 2027; rates noted as subject to Board approval summer 2026). Single/private room would be $7,914/year.
